spans.s:
मीढ, अस्, आ, अम्, passed (as urine); urined,
watered; (अम्), n., also मीऌह, अम्, n., Ved. a
battle, combat, struggle.

मीढ मीढ, मीढ्वस्, मीढुषे, मीऌहुषे,
&c. See col. 1.

मीढुष, अस्, m., N. of a son of Indra by
Paulomī.

मीढ्वस्, आन्, असी, अस् (the declension follows that
of a perf. part., e. g. acc. sing. masc. मीढ्वांसम्,
dat. मीढुषे or मीऌहुषे, cf. Mahā-bh. Vana-p.
1628, voc. Ved. मीढवस्), bountiful, liberal (applied
to Rudra, Agni, Varuṇa, Mitra, Viṣṇu, Parjanya,
and Indra); pouring forth seed (= रेतः-सेक्तृ),
prolific (applied to a goat); N. of a son of Dakṣa.
—मीढुष्-टम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most bountiful
or liberal; (अस्), m. the sun; Śiva; a thief.
